c.tagline: Temple bells, mountain air, and chaos woven into ancient courtyards.

taxi.fareNote: Meters are often 'broken'; agree fare upfront or insist on the meter (bhada) before departing.

emergency.note: Tourist Police: +977-1-4247041; response times and resources are limited outside central areas.

avoid.reason: Fake trekking-guide and "friendly student" scams in Thamel; pickpocketing in crowds; sort trekking permits officially

hood_desc: The backpacker and trekking hub with narrow lanes packed with gear shops, budget guesthouses, bars, and travel agents; suits first-timers, trekkers, and nightlife seekers.
Quiet Tibetan Buddhist quarter centered on the giant whitewashed stupa, ringed by monasteries and thangka shops; suits culture and spirituality-focused travelers wanting a calmer base.
A historic Newari city across the Bagmati river with a UNESCO Durbar Square, artisan courtyards, and boutique cafes; suits culture lovers wanting fewer crowds than central Kathmandu.
Leafy, upscale diplomatic and residential enclave close to the center with embassies and quiet tree-lined streets; suits business travelers and those wanting comfort with easy access.
Central boulevard near the Royal Palace with high-end shops, airlines offices, and legacy luxury hotels; suits travelers wanting a polished, central base.

water.note: Avoid tap water; drink only bottled, filtered, or boiled water.

transit.pay: Cash paid to the conductor on board for most buses and microbuses; Sajha Yatayat has some smart-card pilot routes but cash is standard. No unified fare card exists valley-wide.
transit.hours: Roughly 6am-8pm; little to no night service, so taxis/ride-hailing apps are used after dark.
transit.note: No metro or rail system exists; most visitors rely on taxis, ride-hailing apps, or walking within neighborhoods.

bus: Greenline and tourist coaches to Pokhara/Chitwan
Long-distance buses from Gongabu (New) Bus Park

transit.m: Prepaid taxi counter (fixed fare) to Thamel
Public bus/microbus to Ratna Park (with luggage impractical)

tip.r: 10% is appreciated at restaurants without a service charge; not expected for taxis, though rounding up is common.
